name: math-workspace
description: Local workspace for mathematical writing, formal review, and project navigation

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build-output.js && npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run build:reader && npm run build:plugin
scripts.build:core: npm run typecheck:cli && vite build --config vite.core.config.ts
scripts.build:cli: npm run typecheck:cli && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts
scripts.build:cli:quiet: npm run --silent typecheck:cli && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --logLevel warn
scripts.build:reader: npm run typecheck:reader && vite build --config vite.reader.config.ts
scripts.workspace: npm run --silent build:cli:quiet && npm run --silent build:reader:quiet && node out/cli/math-workspace.js
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run workspace -- verify
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:migrations
scripts.content:build: vasmc build && node scripts/postprocess-skills.js && node scripts/postprocess-readme.js
scripts.prepack: npm run content:build && npm run build
scripts.release:local: npm run content:build && npm run build && node out/cli/math-workspace.js verify && npm run test:migrations && node out/cli/release.js
scripts.release:marketplace:local: npm run content:build && npm run build && node out/cli/math-workspace.js verify && npm run test:migrations && node out/cli/release.js --marketplace-root ../marketplace
scripts.release:check: node --check scripts/publish-release.js && npm run test:release && npm run release:local && npm_config_cache=/private/tmp/math-workspace-npm-cache npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts && git diff --check
scripts.release:prepare: npm run release:marketplace:local && node --check scripts/publish-release.js && npm run test:release && npm_config_cache=/private/tmp/math-workspace-npm-cache npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts && git diff --check && git -C ../marketplace diff --check
